features.name: Audio Understanding
features.subtitle: Listen for structure before making a prediction.
features.description: I study music information retrieval, acoustic scene classification, and perceptually aligned audio evaluation. My work connects signal-level evidence with robust experimental methodology.

features.name: Generative Audio
features.subtitle: Treat generation as a system that can be measured.
features.description: I work with diffusion and symbolic-music generation models, including MusicXML-to-audio expressive rendering. The focus is controllable generation and evaluation rather than generation alone.

features.name: Trustworthy AI
features.subtitle: Turn privacy and copyright questions into testable methods.
features.description: I develop membership-inference, adversarial, and voice-protection methods for generative audio. Membership inference asks whether a particular work was used to train a model.

features.name: Research to Product
features.subtitle: Carry an idea from method to usable proof of concept.
features.description: As Principal Investigator of a Suzhou concept-verification project, I own model development, macOS product requirements, evaluation design, and user trials for a creator-facing music tool.

faq.a: Machine-learning scientist and engineer roles in audio understanding, music intelligence, generative audio, and trustworthy AI.

faq.q: When is Yuxuan available to start?
faq.a: He expects to complete his Ph.D. in March 2027 and is targeting 2027 graduate or early-career hiring timelines.

faq.q: What is the core research contribution?
faq.a: Methods for auditing generative audio models, attacking and evaluating music systems, and aligning technical metrics with auditory perception.

faq.q: Does the work include product ownership?
faq.a: Yes. He is Principal Investigator for a MusicXML-to-audio PoC that reached TRL 5 and includes model, app, evaluation, and user-trial ownership.

faq.q: Does Yuxuan have industry audio experience?
faq.a: Yes. At Changba he worked on singing-voice generation and enhancement through audio simulation, algorithm testing, and evaluation.

faq.q: Where can I find the complete publication record?
faq.a: The selected list appears on this page and the complete record is linked through Google Scholar.

footer.ethos: Methods that listen carefully and claims that can be tested.
